idea-plugin.name: Codex App Launcher [Beta]
idea-plugin.description:
English

Codex App Launcher [Beta] connects IntelliJ IDEA with the Codex desktop app, making it easier to open projects and copy precise code references without manually typing file paths or line numbers.

Platform support: Opening Codex App supports Windows and macOS. Copying code references is available on every platform.

  • Open the current IntelliJ IDEA project directly in Codex App from the main toolbar.
  • Copy selected code with its project-relative file path and exact line range.
  • Copy the selected code reference, or the current file reference when there is no selection, from the editor context menu using Copy as Code Reference, placed right above Copy / Paste Special, or with Ctrl+Shift+C.
  • References go to the clipboard, ready to paste into the Codex App input.
  • Customize the Windows PowerShell launch command in the IDE settings.

Project paths are resolved to their real absolute locations before Codex App is launched. Project launching supports Windows and macOS.

中文

Codex App Launcher [Beta] 用于连接 IntelliJ IDEA 与 Codex 桌面应用， 让开发者无需手动拼写文件路径和行号，即可在 Codex App 中打开项目并复制准确的代码引用。

平台支持：打开 Codex App 支持 Windows 和 macOS；复制代码引用在所有平台都可以使用。

  • 通过 IDEA 主工具栏直接在 Codex App 中打开当前项目。
  • 复制选中的代码，自动携带项目相对路径和准确行号范围。
  • 通过编辑器右键菜单中的 Copy as Code Reference（位于 Copy / Paste Special 上方）或快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+C 复制选中的代码引用；未选中代码时复制当前文件引用。
  • 引用只会复制到剪贴板，可以直接粘贴到 Codex App 输入框。
  • 可以在 IDEA 设置中自定义 Windows PowerShell 启动命令。

插件会先将项目路径解析为真实绝对路径，再启动 Codex App。 项目启动支持 Windows 和 macOS。
